notes: Marginal note Hebrew shoulder glosses katheph, rendered side; not an alignment factor.

s025+s026 carries the supplied lieth alongside over/before on the pattern of rule 30's לִפְנֵי → was before, reading lieth as the locative predicate's supplied copula. The competing reading treats lieth as a whole lexical verb and marks it added under rules 20 and 30; the unit note records the choice taken.
